claim: The 74 modes are the complete set
test: Compare with public NWS VCP material; add one supplemental low cut (-0.2 to 0.4 deg) to the worst mode
criterion: Every operational VCP and lowest angle is in the table, or the gap is listed with its effect
key_result: 74 modes use a 0.5 deg lowest cut; public NWS lists sites with a supplemental cut at -0.2 to +0.4 deg (4 sites at -0.2). Adding one such cut to the worst mode raises the MAG by up to 3.10 dB (99 to 99.999%, takeoff -0.2 to 0.5 deg).
